QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_33

question.text: An AIF scheme cannot have more than how many investors in one single scheme, per the CTR disclosure item on 'Number of investors in the AIF'?

answer.text: 1,000 investors (Accredited Investors excluded from the count).

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 12 (Table 12.1): 'An AIF cannot have more than 1000 investors in one single scheme. However, Accredited Investors shall be excluded from the count.' The Trap: 49 is the Companies Act private-placement limit for non-QIBs per issue. 200 is a company-law limit on members for unlisted companies. 'Unlimited' contradicts the express cap. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C identical. Angel Funds (a Cat I sub-category) have a different limit (up to 200) — do not confuse.
